Angle.description: An angle in degrees: a number, to at most 9 decimals (nanodegrees). An exponent is read exactly; Silico writes plain decimals. (Strings are reserved for expressions, which aren't read yet.)

Camera.description:
A camera: where it looks from and at, which way is up in the image, and how much it
sees. The document is Z-up. A result's camera can be passed back unchanged.

eye.description:
The eye, in global coordinates (mm), within 1e12 mm of the origin, at least a
nanometre from the target. An orthographic view uses only its direction from the
target; a perspective eye mustn't be inside a body or on its surface.

field_of_view.description:
A perspective camera's vertical angle, in degrees, from 0.001 to 179.999; null for
an orthographic camera.

target.description: What the view is centred on, in global coordinates (mm).

up.description:
Which way is up in the image: any vector with a part across the view, made
perpendicular to the view and of unit length in a result.

view_height.description:
An orthographic camera's view's height, in mm, from 1e-6 to 1e12; null for a
perspective camera.

FeatureId.description: A feature's ID: 8 characters of Crockford's base32 in lower case (digits and letters but i, l, o, and u).

HeldMesh.description: A mesh the client holds, as `held` gives it.

deflection.description: The `deflection` a meshes result gave the mesh, as it gave it.

key.description: Its body's `key`, as a meshes result gave it.

Length.description: A length in millimetres: a number, to at most 6 decimals (nanometres). An exponent is read exactly; Silico writes plain decimals. (Strings are reserved for expressions, which aren't read yet.)

ModelChoice.description: Which model to read: the current one, or the newest published.

oneOf.description:
The session's current revision's model, rebuilt if it isn't yet: what an agent that
just edited reads.

The newest model published, which may be an older revision's, read at once: what a
UI reads while a rebuild runs.

NamedView.description:
A named view, as Fusion's ViewCube names them, the document Z-up: `front` looks from
−Y, `right` from +X, `top` from +Z, and the corners combine them.

Projection.description:
How a camera projects: from the eye in parallel (`orthographic`, as every named view
is), or from the eye as a point (`perspective`).

request.description:
`meshes`' request: the display meshes of the model's bodies for a view, from a named
view or a camera (one, the other null), each body at the largest power of two no coarser
than half a pixel, as `render` meshes it. Every body asked is meshed, never culled to the
view.

camera.description: A camera; null with a named view.

features.description: The features whose solids to mesh, by ID, each once; null for every body.

held.description:
The meshes the client holds already, each its key and deflection as a result gave
them: a body held is named, but its geometry isn't given again.

session.description: The session's ID, as `open` gave it.

view.description: A named view, fitted to the bodies; null with a camera.

MeshEdge.description: An edge of a body's mesh.

name.description: Its name, by the element map.

points.description:
How many of `edge_points` are its polyline's, the next after the edges' before it;
null when the body is held.

MeshFace.description: A face of a body's mesh.

name.description:
Its name, by the element map: give it to `distance`, `angle`, or `render`'s
`highlight`, or, if it's stable, to a fillet's `edges`.

stable.description: Whether `name` is stable: one a reference stored in the document may use.

triangles.description:
How many of the mesh's triangles are its, the next in `triangles` after the faces'
before it; null when the body is held.

body.description:
Its number among the model's bodies, from 1, as a render's ID buffer numbers it;
null for a feature's solid that isn't a body (one another feature consumes).

box.description: Its tight box, `[min, max]`, in mm; null if it couldn't be measured.

deflection.description: The deflection the kernel used: the level, or the body's floor, which is coarser.

edge_points.description: The points of every edge's polyline, one edge after another, in `edges`' order.

edges.description: Each edge, in the solid's own order (`Edge1` first).

faces.description: Each face, in the solid's own order (`Face1` first).

feature.description: The feature whose solid it is.

held.description:
Whether the client holds this mesh (its key at its deflection): then `positions`,
`normals`, `triangles`, and `edge_points` are empty, and each face's and edge's count
null.

key.description:
Its step's key: the same mesh has the same key, on every platform, and a change to
anything it's built from changes it.

level.description: The deflection, in mm, the view asked for: a power of two.

normals.description: One per position: the unit normal of its face's surface there, out of the solid.

positions.description: The mesh's vertices, in the document's coordinates (mm), shared within a face.

serves.description:
The half pixels, in mm, `[at_least, below]`, this mesh serves: read again only when
the view's half pixel at the body's nearest point leaves them.

triangles.description:
Vertex indices, three a triangle, wound counterclockwise seen from outside, face by
face in `faces`' order.

Projection.description:
How a camera projects: from the eye in parallel (`orthographic`, as every named view
is), or from the eye as a point (`perspective`).

bodies.description: Each body meshed, in timeline order.

camera.description:
The camera of the view: the one given, or the named view's, its up made
perpendicular to the view and of unit length.
